assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key-area polygons are provisional (agent inferred from public announcement text and approximate areas). They are NOT official redlines and must be recalculated when official polygons are released.
assumptions.impact: All area-derived metrics (site area, green ratio, public-space ratio, building footprint) are indicative only; they cannot be used for statutory or precise-area conclusions.

assumptions.statement: All proposal content, geometry, figures, metrics, and narrative were generated by an AI agent (model: opencode/longcat-2.0-free) from public or cleared materials registered in sources.json.
assumptions.impact: Facts, sources, copyrights, spatial data, and metrics are the responsibility of the AI agent; professional review may require revision.

assumptions.statement: Spatial metrics are rounded to remove false precision; confidence is low where geometry is provisional. When official geometry arrives, all metrics must be recomputed.
assumptions.impact: Metric values are indicative design evidence, not authoritative planning control values.
